messages.content:
Read one passage of a document about machines at work (law, manual, guidance, internal guideline,
plant record) and write down the important facts it states.

Answer with one line per fact, fields separated by " | ", nothing else, no header, no code fence:
subject | predicate | object | condition | quote
- predicate: a short camelCase verb phrase of your choice.
- condition: any condition or exception, or "" if none.
- quote: the words of the passage the fact comes from.
At most 12 facts. If the passage states nothing important, answer with the single word NONE.

Passage: REG, Annex III, 3.4.4

3.4.4. Falling objects Where, in the case of self-propelled machinery with a ride-on driver, operator(s) or other person(s), there is a risk due to falling objects or material, the machinery shall be designed and constructed in such a way as to take account of this risk and fitted, if its size allows, with an appropriate protective structure. This structure shall be such that, in the event of falling objects or material, it guarantees the ride-on person(s) an adequate deflection-limiting volume. In order to verify that the structure complies with the requirement laid down in the second paragraph, the manufacturer shall, for each type of structure concerned, perform appropriate tests or have such tests performed.

response.text:
self-propelled machinery with ride-on operator(s) | shall be designed and constructed to take account of falling objects or material risk | risk due to falling objects or material exists | "the machinery shall be designed and constructed in such a way as to take account of this risk"
machinery | shall be fitted with an appropriate protective structure | its size allows | "fitted, if its size allows, with an appropriate protective structure"
protective structure | shall guarantee ride-on person(s) an adequate deflection-limiting volume | in the event of falling objects or material | "it guarantees the ride-on person(s) an adequate deflection-limiting volume"
manufacturer | shall perform or have performed appropriate tests on the protective structure | for each type of structure concerned, to verify compliance | "the manufacturer shall, for each type of structure concerned, perform appropriate tests or have such tests performed"
